title: What do you divide by?
text: Simplifying a fraction means dividing the numerator and the denominator by the same number. That number has to be a common factor. A common mistake is to subtract the same amount from the top and the bottom, which changes the value. What is the greatest whole number that divides both 18 and 24?

title: Divide the numerator
text: The greatest common factor is 6, because $$18 = 6 \times 3$$ and $$24 = 6 \times 4$$. Divide the numerator by that factor. What is $$18 \div 6$$?

title: Divide the denominator
text: Divide the denominator by the same factor, or the value changes. What is $$24 \div 6$$?

title: Worked solution
text: $$\frac{18}{24} = \frac{18 \div 6}{24 \div 6} = \frac{3}{4}$$. Common mistake: dividing the top by 6 and the bottom by something else, or subtracting 6 from both. General rule: divide the numerator and the denominator by their greatest common factor. The fraction keeps the same value because you divided by $$\frac{6}{6} = 1$$.
